name: Gemini maneuver hand controller
view: the maneuver hand controller from behind, as the command pilot sees it beneath the left instrument panel: the T-handle on its shaft above the housing; pushed fore / aft, left / right and up / down to fire the translation thrusters
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the T-handle and housing reconstructed from the public Gemini spacecraft descriptions (NASA Gemini familiarization manual overview, Smithsonian museum descriptions, Wikipedia) and public museum photos looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
